==20%==

'''Southwest''': You joined from the bottom, went right, returned from the right and took the third exit which is southwest.

==15%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |The colourful couple Mr and Mrs Scarlet have six pet dogs – Rocket, Olaf, Yogi, Gnasher, Buster and Iggy. They’ve just welcomed a new dog to the family. What will they name it?
|-
|'''Venus'''
|Mars
|Jupiter
|}
The names all start with letters that represent the colours of the rainbow – R for Red, O for Orange, Y for Yellow, G for Green, B for Blue and I for Indigo. The new dog’s name must start with V for Violet.

[[File:Dice.png|frameless]]

You can see all the numbers 1 to 6 once here and they add up to 21. The opposite faces of the dice will add up to the same number.
